title: Progress Heartbeat
summary: Tells a working job from a stalled one using its heartbeat, so nobody waits on a dead job or kills a live one.
description: Progress bar that separates working from stalled (no heartbeat for N seconds: "No progress for 40s" with Retry), alive-but-not-advancing from silence, shows a time-left range that widens instead of a jumpy countdown, and holds at 99% until the job reports done.
catches: Jumpy countdowns: a widening time-left range instead
100% shown before the job finishes: held at 99%
limits: Needs heartbeat and progress timestamps from your job
Time-left range is an estimate from recent samples
Retry and cancel are your callbacks
a11y: role=progressbar with min, max, now and aria-valuetext including the status
Status is text with icons aria-hidden
Bar motion is reduced under reduced motion
stops: Killed a job that was still running
